title: gamecenter.json
description: A game and its achievements, as game-center registers them. Embed it in the game's page inside <script type="application/gamecenter+json">, or serve it as gamecenter.json beside the page.

id.description: Globally unique slug, claimed when the author approves the registration.

author.description: The author's game-center handle. The named account approves the registration on the hub, which is what completes it.

url.description: Where the game is played. Optional: a manifest the hub fetched is already at the game's URL. Required only when the manifest is pasted into the dashboard. https, or http for localhost.

icon.description: Icon URL. May be relative to the manifest's location.

key.description: Unique within the game. What unlock() names.

hidden.description: Hide the title and description until it is unlocked.
